verdict.rationale: Linear documents an agent that drafts updates, edits text, writes code and runs Loops. None of the evidence shows asking a question and getting an instant answer with citations from workspace content. The ChatGPT deep research and Notion AI connectors are third-party tools, so they earn no credit, and "Write with Agent" is an adjacent drafting feature, not cited Q&A.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
